summary: Assist to RMRG with a search near the Eldora Ski area
notes: Alpine 2016 Missions PDF item 16-42. Search ran 06/02; paged 06/01 Merged Mountain-Ear story (run 610): left foot/ankle bones found in a single size-13 Rugged snow boot at Eldora Mountain Resort on 2016-06-01; multi-agency fingertip search (~180 acres) with six Front Range Rescue cadaver dogs found no additional remains; DNA profile entered in a national database; remains not connected to the two missing men (incl. Ryder Johnson). Case 16-3148. | MERGE run 709: BCSO June 2, 2016 update release (case 16-3148): Eldora human-remains search concluded, no additional remains or evidence found; search covered ~180 acres | MERGE run 871: BCSO June 2, 2016 pre-conclusion update release (case 16-3148) MERGE run 873: remains identified as Ervin Mettler, 83, camping near Eldora (per Daily Camera via UN 2016-10-19); initially thought to be missing resort employee Ryder Johnson (last seen leaving Eldora 2016-01-17) — not his remains. Eldora 16-3148 follow-up RESOLVED.
